compiled_state.title: [T4][GREEN] Verify verifier uses get_artifacts_dir() correctly for all contexts
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Confirm pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh (from story 1283) calls get_artifacts_dir() which derives from REPO_ROOT — no changes needed if it already does this correctly. If not, fix it so verifier always reads from the correct worktree's ARTIFACTS_DIR.
Architecture note: get_artifacts_dir() in plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh derives ARTIFACTS_DIR from 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' (REPO_ROOT). Different worktrees have different REPO_ROOT → different ARTIFACTS_DIRs. This is correct.
Classification: GREEN; Dependencies: T3 (536c-cd2a-13f7-4074)
